purpose: Preview samples only; no production assets replaced

samples.subject: the triangular wooden ship bow ram with dark iron fittings
samples.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: single transparent PNG game equipment art preview, 普通 / Common rarity.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, not a loose style reference. It shows the triangular wooden ship bow ram with dark iron fittings. Make exactly ONE edited image of this SAME component.
Primary request: add a refined rarity aura that tightly follows the actual irregular silhouette of the equipment. The aura MUST trace every convex and concave contour of this specific object, including protrusions, indentations and meaningful open gaps. The glow is essentially a soft luminous expansion of the object's alpha silhouette. It must conform to the component's shape, never a circle or ellipse surrounding it.
Keep the original component design, shape, proportions, framing, orientation, wood/metal/cloth colors, weathering, engraving, and all construction details as faithful and unchanged as possible. This is only a contour-lighting edit, not a redesign. Keep the complete component visible and centered with clear transparent padding.
Color palette for the added glow ONLY: #B8C0C8 silver-gray, luminous cool silver-white. A narrow clean luminous rim hugging the silhouette, then a soft outward bloom extending roughly 2–4% of the canvas width and fading smoothly to fully transparent. A little soft reflected rim light on the very edge is allowed; do not recolor the object or obscure detail. Use the same polished restrained intensity across rarity levels so hue is the main discriminator. Preserve the painterly realistic nautical game art style. Avoid streaks, sparks, decorative stars, new runes, new parts, or flames.
Background: genuine alpha transparency, including outside the halo and in larger cutout gaps, preserve soft semitransparent glow. No opaque backdrop, no checkerboard painted into pixels, no cast shadow or floor.
Avoid: geometric halo circle, ellipse, badge, frame, circular light disk, filled colored backing, neon tubes, outline far away from the object, new typography, labels, watermark. Output a single isolated component with a silhouette-following glow, no comparison collage.
